messages:
maria_ops: Heads up — vendor flagged 6 leased H100s in the return batch: thermal sensor alerts during soak. Vendor gave 2 options: depot repair (EU depot, ~10–14 days) or immediate air replacement from EU pool (2–3 days) with cross-region routing possible. Need routing decision, cluster impact below.
liam_purchasing: cost diff and surcharge for cross-region? cc @sanjay_logistics
vendor_ops: Cross-region outbound is allowed. Depot repair no surcharge. Air-replace incurs 12% freight and customs handling surcharge (estimate). Lead times as stated.
sanjay_logistics: If we air-replace from EU to APAC, customs in SG will add ~48–72h clearance risk. If we consolidate with upcoming APAC batch (ETA 5d) we could avoid surcharge but delay replacement.
anya_supply: Depot repair keeps units on our EU depot warranty queue — cheaper but 10–14 days is optimistic if parts backlog. Also risk of additional thermal failures during repair testing.
maria_ops: Cluster note: eu-west1 raster cluster has two racks at 85% usable GPU capacity; losing 6 H100s will push a couple prod queues over threshold. We need at least 3 replacements within 72h to avoid SLA alerts.
liam_purchasing: Proposal: air-expedite 3 units (cover critical racks), depot repair remaining 3. Approve surcharge up to $18,500 total. @vendor_ops can you confirm availability of 3 immediate air units?
vendor_ops: Confirmed. We can stage 3 for Tuesday ETD with standard export docs. AWB and flight ETA will be shared after booking. Cross-region OK but surcharge applies to whole shipment.
sanjay_logistics: I'll book space once liam confirms spend. I'll need AWB template data. Example manifest snippet: `AWB: 125-ETD-EU4321, Pkgs:3, Weight:210kg, Content:H100 units, Incoterm:DAP`. Customs docs prepared.
rma_bot: RMA created: `RMA-20260315-9921`. Depot repair queue reference: `DEPOT-EU-7782`. Tracking will be attached to the RMA when AWB issued.
anya_supply: Recommend we pre-stage the cooling swap kits and firmware image on the 3 replacements so ops can hot-swap and image immediately. Saves ~4–6h onsite config.
maria_ops: Agreed — pre-stage images + cooling kit. Action items: @liam_purchasing approve $18,500 (surcharge cap) — done? @sanjay_logistics book AWB once vendor sends manifest. @vendor_ops attach export docs and final AWB. I'll open an incident ticket to track cluster capacity impact.
liam_purchasing: Approved up to $18,500. Proceed. :white_check_mark:
sanjay_logistics: Booking in progress, will post AWB + ETA within 90m. :truck:
vendor_ops: Export docs attached to vendor portal, will email AWB once space confirmed.
maria_ops: Thanks — setting expectation: 3 units air, 3 depot. If depot slips past 14d escalate to air replacement for remaining units. :eyes:
